claims.claim: Over the 90 days to 2026-11-11 the protocol minted 8.03M NEAR, an annual issuance rate of 2.49% of supply. The protocol maximum is 2.5% a year.
claims.source: NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv)

claims.claim: Gas fees burnt in the same 90 days were 78.51K NEAR, which offsets 0.98% of issuance. Gas burn alone does not fund security.
claims.source: NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv)

claims.claim: The ledger covers 1,641 epochs from 2025-07-01 to 2026-11-12 with 0 epochs missing, and the header supply differs from the NearBlocks supply figure by 0.0020%.
claims.source: NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv); NearBlocks daily chart (data/raw/nearblocks_daily.csv), third party

claims.claim: Of the gas fees users paid over 90 days (96.72K NEAR per NearBlocks), 81.2% left the supply according to block headers.
claims.source: NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv); NearBlocks daily chart (data/raw/nearblocks_daily.csv), third party

claims.claim: NEAR Intents settled $134.94M a day over 90 days, 223% above the same 90 days a year earlier.
Users paid 0.156% of Intents volume in fees. NEAR captured 0.042% of volume as revenue; the rest stayed with solvers and front ends.
Captured Intents revenue used to buy NEAR was $5.11M over 90 days, 17.7% of the USD value of issuance. That is 18 times what gas burn returned.
claims.source: DefiLlama near-intents adapter (data/raw/llama_intents_*.csv), third party; NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv)

claims.claim: Burn plus buyback returned 18.8% of issuance, so holders were still diluted at a net 2.03% a year.
claims.source: NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv); DefiLlama near-intents adapter (data/raw/llama_intents_*.csv), third party

claims.claim: At the 90-day capture rate and a NEAR price of $3.58, Intents volume of $754.85M a day would offset all issuance. That is 5.6 times the current run rate.
Read the other way: today's Intents volume fully offsets issuance only if NEAR trades at $0.64 or lower. The market price is $3.58.
44.4% of supply is staked. Liquid staking share prices grew at 4.25% a year over 90 days (after pool fees), which is 1.78% once net supply growth is taken off.
claims.source: validators RPC and staking pool view calls (data/raw/samples.csv)

claims.claim: 351 validators secure the chain. The 9 largest hold more than a third of stake and the ten largest hold 36.3%.
claims.source: validators RPC and staking pool view calls (data/raw/samples.csv)

claims.claim: NEAR's market value is $4.70B: 227 times annualised buyback revenue and 61 times annualised gross Intents fees.
claims.source: NEAR block headers via archival RPC (data/raw/epochs.csv); NearBlocks daily chart (data/raw/nearblocks_daily.csv), third party; DefiLlama near-intents adapter (data/raw/llama_intents_*.csv), third party

claims.claim: Base-layer activity over 90 days averaged 744,389 transactions and 71,693 active accounts a day; the 365-day averages are 1,892,794 and 138,756.

The three accounts that revenue.near.org lists for captured Intents revenue held 1.22M NEAR on 2026-02-27 and 4.25M NEAR on 2026-11-11, read from chain. The rise of 3.03M NEAR is 0.97 times the NEAR that DefiLlama's buyback revenue for the same days ($7.86M) buys at daily prices.
claims.source: view_account on the accounts revenue.near.org lists (data/raw/samples.csv); DefiLlama near-intents adapter (data/raw/llama_intents_*.csv), third party

kill_criteria.criterion: Intents volume over 90 days falls below the same 90 days a year earlier.
The captured revenue rate falls below 0.02% of volume (fee competition takes the margin).
Buyback revenue falls below 10% of issuance for a 90-day window.
Realised issuance rises back above 3% a year (the 2025 inflation cut is undone).
The break-even multiple is higher than it was 90 days ago (volume is losing ground to issuance).
Fewer than 7 validators can hold a third of stake.
